# Rules version change log

The engine keeps rules versions 9 to 28. Version 28 is stored in full (`data/rules/v28.json`); every older version is a change file against the next newer one (`v27.json` against 28, and so on). Each section below lists what that older version differs in, read from the loaded rules: the value in the older version first, the next version's value in brackets. A game version picks its rules version with `logic_data_version` (see [versions](../versions.md)). Values are shown as stored: health, attack and defence in tenths.

## Rules v28

The current rules (game versions 120 to 124). See the other reference documents for their content.
